concept.verdict: Three jade levels, narrow mast/brass neck and fork agree with legacy. Concept thickens disc rims, enlarges the gold crown and makes ambiguous roof features crescent-shaped; retain the established thinner levels, compact crown and modest round cuts instead.

feedback: Actual independent GLB retains the three broad rounded levels, narrow connected central column, brass exposed neck/pale retainers, tapered mast and compact open crown visible in the legacy presentation.

All five mapped body solids and both refined crown arms retain original evaluated geometry; full colour/roughness pixels and ten planar caps/cylindrical side UV contracts pass in saved-native and imported GLB.

Concept thickens level rims and enlarges the crown; its crescent roof cuts are unsupported geometry. These are rejected in favor of the retained legacy-guided proportions. Existing round roof wells/sleeves/floors/fins are an authored interpretation of ambiguous dark source details, not recovered engineering.

Only seven rim/collar/groove seams are reduced. Command/research-coordination function is documented; no crown role or operating motion is invented from catalogue reveal/highlight. Fine surface contrast and wear are subtler in the established material maps than in the concept.
